normalized.result: Tucking delete at the bottom of the edit form feels safer and less cluttered to me. Either way the same named confirmation protects me from an accident, so both are safe in that sense. But a delete button sitting on every card, right next to the everyday actions, feels like something I could hit by mistake while just browsing, and it adds visual noise to each card. Keeping delete inside the edit form means I only reach it when I've deliberately gone in to manage that one bookmark. So I'd go with delete in the edit form.
